record.original_question: For the trigonometric Abel differential equations x' = (a0 + a1 sin t + a2 cos t)x^3 + (b0 + b1 sin t + b2 cos t)x^2, is 3 the maximum possible number of 2pi-periodic limit cycles?

evidence.quote: Problem 6. Consider the family of trigonometric Abel differential equations (...) Is 3 its maximum number of 2pi periodic limit cycles?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the family of trigonometric Abel differential equations
  x'(t) = (a_0 + a_1 sin t + a_2 cos t) x(t)^3 + (b_0 + b_1 sin t + b_2 cos t) x(t)^2,
where a_0, a_1, a_2, b_0, b_1, b_2 are real parameters. A 2π-periodic limit cycle is an isolated 2π-periodic solution of this equation (in the space of 2π-periodic solutions). Determine whether 3 is the maximum possible number of 2π-periodic limit cycles attained over all choices of the parameters (a_0, a_1, a_2, b_0, b_1, b_2) ∈ ℝ^6, and prove this bound is sharp.
artifact.status_search_result: A 2023 paper by Yu, Huang, and Liu (arXiv:2309.00510, published in J. Differential Equations, 2024) establishes that for the classical Abel equation x' = g(t)x^3 + f(t)x^2 with g and f linear trigonometric polynomials, the maximum number of limit cycles is exactly 3, resolving this case of the Smale–Pugh problem (and the specific question about the trigonometric Abel family with sin t, cos t coefficients).

status_evidence.title: Maximum number of limit cycles for Abel equation having coefficients with linear trigonometric functions
status_evidence.snippet: The authors completely solve the simplest case of the Smale-Pugh problem, i.e., the case when g(t) and f(t) are linear trigonometric.
status_evidence.claim: The maximum number of limit cycles for the trigonometric Abel equation with linear trigonometric coefficients has been determined.

status_evidence.title: Maximum number of limit cycles for Abel equation having coefficients with linear trigonometric functions - ScienceDirect
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work has proven that the equation has at most three limit cycles when both coefficients are linear trigonometric functions.
status_evidence.claim: It is proved that the maximum number of limit cycles in this family equals 3.
